Invisible jukeboxes with custom musics to enhance your lobby/spawn experience.

## **🎶 AstralMusic**

With AstralMusic, you can place invisible jukeboxes in specific areas such as lobbies, spawns, hubs, or waiting zones. These jukeboxes automatically play custom music tracks in a loop, creating a polished and atmospheric environment for players.

All music is loaded via a resource pack (an example resource pack is included with the plugin), allowing full customization of sounds and playlists.

## **Commands:**

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d19fd4908a9b4dc966fcd6e8945966ff25c23ba.png)

**Tutorial:**

### **✨ Features:**
- Invisible jukeboxes placed anywhere in the world
- Custom music playback using resource packs
- Looping playlists for continuous background music
- Per-jukebox volume control
- Random and sequential playback modes
- Commands to start, stop, skip, and manage songs
- Perfect for lobbies, spawns, hubs, and waiting areas


AstralMusic **requires** a resource pack to play custom sounds.
An example resource pack is included with the plugin (witch contain copyrights), showing the correct structure and configuration for custom music.
